class.name: CgameItemLedger
class.brief_description: Per-server item ownership ledger that takes part in two-phase commits.
class.description: [CgameItemLedger] gives items globally unique ids ([code]"i<server>-<n>"[/code]), moves them between servers exactly once and detects duplicates. Items are [code]"active"[/code] (usable), [code]"locked"[/code] (prepared for an outgoing move) or [code]"quarantined"[/code] (suspected duplicate, frozen until [method resolve_duplicate] decides). A ledger is a participant of [CgameTransactionCoordinator]: register [method prepare], [method commit] and [method abort] as the three callables. A transaction operation is [code]{"kind": "out", "ids": [...]}[/code] on the source and [code]{"kind": "in", "recs": [...]}[/code] on the target. All three steps are idempotent, so re-delivered decisions are harmless. The static helpers inspect several ledgers at once, for example after a crash.

method.name: mint
method.description: Creates a new active item and returns its unique id.

method.name: has_item
method.description: Returns whether the ledger holds the item in any state.

method.name: state_of
method.description: Returns the item state, or an empty string for an unknown item.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether the item exists and is usable.

method.name: owner_of
method.description: Returns the item's owner, or an empty string for an unknown item.

method.name: epoch_of
method.description: Returns how many server moves the item has made, or [code]-1[/code] for an unknown item.

method.name: total_count
method.description: Returns the number of items in any state.

method.name: active_count
method.description: Returns the number of active items.

method.name: ids_sorted
method.description: Returns all item ids in sorted order.

method.name: items_of
method.description: Returns the sorted ids of the active items owned by [param owner].

method.name: snapshot
method.description: Returns deep copies of the item records for the given ids (unknown ids are skipped), ready to travel in an [code]"in"[/code] operation.

method.name: prepare
method.description: Votes on a transaction. An [code]"out"[/code] operation locks the items and fails if any is missing, locked or quarantined; an [code]"in"[/code] operation fails if the ledger already holds one of the ids. Repeating a prepare returns the earlier vote.

method.name: commit
method.description: Applies a prepared transaction: removes outgoing items, or adds incoming ones with their epoch increased by one. Idempotent.

method.name: abort
method.description: Drops a prepared transaction and unlocks outgoing items. Idempotent.

method.name: quarantine_item
method.description: Freezes an item until it is resolved.

method.name: find_duplicates
method.description: Returns [code]{item id: [server ids]}[/code] for every id held by more than one of the given ledgers, in any state.

method.name: quarantine_duplicates
method.description: Quarantines every copy of every duplicated id and returns the sorted ids.

method.name: resolve_duplicate
method.description: Keeps the copy with the highest epoch (ties: lowest server id) active and deletes the others. Returns the surviving server id, or [code]-1[/code] if the id is unknown.

method.name: to_dict
method.description: Serialises the ledger to a dictionary that survives a JSON round trip.

method.name: from_dict
method.description: Restores the ledger from [method to_dict] output.

members.member: Id of the server that owns this ledger. It is part of every minted item id.
Prepared transactions keyed by transaction id.
Idempotence memory: transaction id to [code]"commit"[/code] or [code]"abort"[/code].
Quarantined item ids with the reason.
